reviews.text: We have been customers of Amaro's Bichos for over 20 years and have always received excellent service.

I've been going there for a few years and we've always received excellent service. The whole team is very attentive and takes care of our dogs with great affection and dedication. It's a place we trust and feel comfortable leaving our pets. I highly recommend it! 🐶❤️ …

Cheaper pet food than COBASI, PETZ, PETLOVE, plus the super attentive staff, the veterinarian Maurício has a bionic eye for any diagnosis, Dr. Mirian is a sweetheart, very careful, phenomenal, assertive in all diagnoses, honest prices, Geraldo who is in charge of bathing and grooming, I've never seen a guy as good as him, you can trust them, do an online search and you'll see that the prices are the best in São Paulo, and free shipping!!!
Thank you so much for your feedback! It's always a pleasure to take care of your furry friend. Come back whenever you need! 🐾 …

I want to congratulate you on the quick service and delivery of my order. My cat is convalescing and eats a specific type of baby food, and the delivery was very fast. Thank you again, I will buy again soon ☺️

I took my dog ​​Cookie for an adaptation period and I was very satisfied with the service. Everyone was extremely professional, helpful, and polite. Since he was traumatized after a bad experience at another pet shop, they were very patient and sensitive, respecting his pace. They even allowed me, as his owner, to bathe him initially so he could feel safe and start the adaptation process gradually. The idea is that, gradually, the team will take over his care as he gains confidence. I was very happy and grateful for all the care, understanding, and professionalism. I highly recommend them! Thank you, Oliver! Thank you, Geraldo!
I sent my Lhasa Apso for a scissor trim and she looks beautiful! The pick-up and drop-off service is also great. The attendant Oliver and the groomer Roberto are very kind. I loved it!

I'd like to leave my testimonial so that other pet owners know that if they need to rely on Amaro's Shop, they will do their best for the customer. I have a convalescent kitten at home, and the only food he can eat is out of stock all over Brazil. Only pet owners know the desperation that sets in at times like these. After spending hours on the phone calling stores in every state imaginable, I managed to find nine blessed cans at Amaro's. The saleswoman, Maricledes Pereira de Souza, was impeccable, as were the people responsible for shipping at the post office and the finance department, Bruno, who processed the payment quickly so that we could ship it before noon, since the next day was a holiday and would have further delayed the shipment to my city. Maricledes, thank you very much to you and the team. Thanks to your efficiency and impeccable service, I gained a few more days of food for my kitten.

I shop at this store frequently and everything has always gone well. But this time the store failed. As always, I check the price before going to the store, and I was given a price for the Gerioox medication. I have a discount from the laboratory, and they even reminded me in that conversation that I could count on this discount. When I arrived at the store, the price quoted was not the same. They were giving a Black Friday discount, but I couldn't have that discount because I already have the laboratory discount. First, it wasn't even mentioned that the price quoted was discounted; second, the laboratory discount is paid by the laboratory, not the store. So I simply couldn't access the same discount as other customers. I explained, I argued, but there was no discussion, they didn't acknowledge any of the errors, and I wasn't entitled to the Black Friday discount.
